_note: Draft — review before the pilot. `speakers` is keyed by the parsed speaker label; `en` is how the narrator names them mid-sentence, `ko` the Korean name, `g` m/f/n for himself/herself. Names in stage directions are looked up by upper-casing them, so 'Lady Capulet' finds LADY CAPULET.
_gloss_note: Shakespeare word meanings for Stage 4. simplify.py adds an entry to the prompt only when its key appears in the raw text of the chunk (whole word, case-insensitive, ’ = '). Keys may be phrases. Fix a recurring misreading by adding or sharpening an entry here, never by editing drafts. Explain single words only; never paraphrase a famous line here (the model will swap the explanation in and lose the line).

gloss.anon: 'coming!' or 'right away' (a reply to someone calling), or 'soon'
gloss.within: (of a voice or noise) from inside, offstage
gloss.counsel: advice (only in the phrase 'stumblest on my counsel' does it mean private thoughts)
gloss.stumblest on my counsel: happen to overhear my private thoughts
gloss.light: (of a woman or love) not serious, too easily won; also: weightless
gloss.strange: distant, reserved, playing hard to get
gloss.cunning to be strange: skill at pretending not to care
gloss.jove: Jupiter, king of the Roman gods
gloss.as sweet repose and rest come to thy hea: may the same sweet peace that is in my heart come to your heart
gloss.maid: an unmarried girl; also a servant. The moon goddess Diana protects unmarried girls, so a virgin is 'the moon's maid'
gloss.vestal: virgin, as in the priestesses of Diana
gloss.vestal livery: the uniform of virginity that the moon gives her servants
gloss.that she knew she were: that she knew she was (my love)
gloss.sphere: the orbit of a star or planet
gloss.adventure: take a risk, dare the journey
gloss.merchandise: a precious prize (Juliet is compared to treasure worth sailing for)
gloss.woo: court, try to win someone's love
gloss.tassel-gentle: a male falcon; she wants to call Romeo back like a falconer calls a hawk
gloss.bondage is hoarse: someone who is not free (watched by family) must whisper
gloss.echo: the nymph Echo of the old story, who could only repeat others' words
gloss.ghostly: spiritual (a 'ghostly father' / 'ghostly sire' is a priest)
gloss.shrift: confession to a priest (and the forgiveness that follows)
gloss.marry: indeed, by the Virgin Mary (a mild oath, not the verb)
gloss.an: (at the start of a condition) if
gloss.sirrah: you there (to a servant or inferior)
gloss.saint: holy person; a lover's word for a beloved woman
gloss.pilgrim: a traveller to a holy place
gloss.exile: being forced to leave home forever
gloss.apothecary: a man who makes and sells medicines
gloss.distilling liquor: a potion that spreads through the body
gloss.shroud: cloth wrapped around a dead body
gloss.county: count (a nobleman's title; Paris is 'the County')
gloss.wormwood: a bitter plant, put on the breast to wean a baby
gloss.queen mab: the fairy queen who brings people dreams
gloss.maskers: people in masks at a party
gloss.torch-bearer: a man who carries a torch (and does not dance)
gloss.pox: a disease; used as a curse
